titleEn: Maximum Number of Words You Can Type
title: 可以输入的最大单词数
summary: 键盘若干字母键损坏，统计文本中完全不含损坏字母、可以输入的单词数。
insight: 把损坏字符放入布尔表，按空格拆词；某词任一字符损坏就不可输入，否则计数。
pitfalls: 文本单词由单空格分隔
必须能输入单词全部字符

solutions.title: 损坏字符集合检查
solutions.idea: 逐词判断是否与损坏字符集合相交。
steps: 每词扫描字符，若均未损坏则 answer++

code.java: class Solution { public int canBeTypedWords(String text,String brokenLetters){boolean[] broken=new boolean[26];for(char letter:brokenLetters.toCharArray())broken[letter-'a']=true;int answer=0;for(String word:text.split(" ")){boolean valid=true;for(char letter:word.toCharArray())if(broken[letter-'a'])valid=false;if(valid)answer++;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun canBeTypedWords(text:String,brokenLetters:String):Int{val broken=BooleanArray(26);for(letter in brokenLetters)broken[letter-'a']=true;return text.split(' ').count{word->word.all{!broken[it-'a']}}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int canBeTypedWords(string text,string brokenLetters){bool broken[26]={};for(char letter:brokenLetters)broken[letter-'a']=true;stringstream stream(text);string word;int answer=0;while(stream>>word){bool valid=true;for(char letter:word)if(broken[letter-'a'])valid=false;answer+=valid;}return answer;} };
